regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, enterprise AI infrastructure, and federal technology demand, but several popular names carry sentiment-heavy or mixed signals. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains modest and extended leaders should not be chased.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要集中在半导体、企业级AI基础设施和联邦科技需求，但部分热门标的较依赖情绪信号或存在方向冲突。由于尚无已完成评分的历史判断，置信度应保持克制，且不宜追逐已明显延伸的领涨股。

theses.thesis: The pack's broadest non-extended convergence combines accelerating government grants, strongly positive insider balance, a substantial patent cluster, and supportive public sentiment [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Ro Khanna's disclosed affiliation adds a policy-network signal [actor:Ro Khanna], while modest relative strength leaves room for the thesis to develop without chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: 该标的是证据包中渠道覆盖最广、且尚未延伸的信号之一：政府补助加速、内部人交易净倾向强劲、专利集群显著，同时公众情绪偏多 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。Ro Khanna披露的关联进一步提供政策网络信号 [actor:Ro Khanna]，而相对强度仍温和，暂不属于追高。
second_order: Semiconductor-equipment theme — stronger memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand
AI-server memory theme — expanding AI infrastructure increases demand for high-bandwidth memory and related components
theses.dissent: The sentiment and media channels may be redundant rather than independent, while the grant amount alone does not establish a material earnings impact.

falsifier.text: Government support stops accelerating and insider transaction balance turns negative while patent momentum weakens.

theses.thesis: Federal-contract acceleration aligns with insider buying, developer momentum, model-download activity, and the largest patent cluster in the pack [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. Material underperformance versus SPY means this is a potential catch-up setup rather than a momentum chase, although earnings in 15 days create near-term event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: 联邦合同加速与内部人买入、开发者动能、模型下载活动及证据包中最大的专利集群相互印证 [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。该股相对SPY明显落后，因此更像潜在补涨而非追逐动量，但15天后的财报带来近期事件风险。
second_order: Federal IT-modernization theme — contract acceleration implies continued agency technology spending
Enterprise AI-software theme — developer adoption can pull through consulting, infrastructure, and integration demand
theses.dissent: The extreme contract-acceleration figure may reflect an unusually weak comparison period, and developer interest may not convert into profitable revenue.

falsifier.text: Federal contract awards normalize sharply and the next earnings report shows no corresponding improvement in enterprise demand.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: Purchases disclosed across four members of Congress align with an analyst-upgrade cluster and a substantial patent footprint [congress_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster]. Its relative underperformance offers a non-extended entry, but the options signal is ambiguous because put/call is slightly above one and volume relative to open interest is not independently decisive [unusual_options].
theses.thesis_zh: 四名国会议员披露的净买入与分析师上调集群及显著专利储备形成一致信号 [congress_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster]。相对表现落后提供了非延伸状态下的切入点，但期权信号较含糊，因为看跌/看涨比略高于一，成交量相对未平仓量也不足以单独定向 [unusual_options]。
second_order: Semiconductor-capex theme — improving equipment demand would imply broader foundry and memory investment
Wafer-fabrication supply chain — higher tool utilization can benefit components, subsystems, and process-control vendors
theses.dissent: Political disclosures and analyst upgrades can lag fundamentals, while weak relative performance may signal a semiconductor-capex slowdown rather than opportunity.

falsifier.text: Semiconductor capital-spending expectations decline further and congressional net activity reverses.

theses.thesis: Developer and model-download momentum aligns with patents, unanimous analyst sentiment in the pack, and disclosed holdings by several politicians [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The actor network is unusually broad, but retail buzz and influencer attention reduce signal purity [retail_buzz] [actor:Jim Cramer].
theses.thesis_zh: 开发者及模型下载动能与专利集群、证据包中的一致看多分析师信号，以及多名政界人士披露的持仓相互呼应 [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。其影响者网络较广，但散户热度和媒体人物关注降低了信号纯度 [retail_buzz] [actor:Jim Cramer]。
second_order: AI-server supply chain — sustained accelerator adoption supports networking, memory, cooling, and power components
Data-center power infrastructure — greater compute deployment raises electricity and grid-interconnection requirements
theses.dissent: Analyst enthusiasm, political holdings, and retail attention may all be reacting to past performance rather than providing forward information.

falsifier.text: Developer activity and model downloads roll over while analyst sentiment deteriorates.

theses.thesis: Positive insider balance and a pro-buy Trump-linked signal point in the same direction [insider_mspr] [trump], while government grants provide a third channel [gov_grant]. The read is tentative because grant acceleration is below one and the clean-energy resolution is expressive rather than a spending authorization.
theses.thesis_zh: 内部人交易净倾向与特朗普关联的买入信号方向一致 [insider_mspr] [trump]，政府补助构成第三个渠道 [gov_grant]。但该判断仍较弱，因为补助加速低于一，且清洁能源周决议主要是立场表达，并非支出授权。
second_order: Nuclear-generation theme — stronger power demand can improve the strategic value of reliable baseload generation
Grid and transmission theme — large-load growth requires additional interconnection and network investment
theses.dissent: Government-grant momentum is decelerating, and proposed large-load cost allocation could temper data-center demand or shift economics away from generators.

falsifier.text: Insider balance turns negative and large-load power demand weakens as grant support continues to decelerate.

theses.thesis: Government-contract acceleration aligns with analyst upgrades and disclosed political and fund relationships [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. Federal fraud-enforcement and information-sharing proposals could reinforce the demand theme [bill:HRES1530] [bill:HR10326], but retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm are crowded signals and the stock is already extended [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull].
theses.thesis_zh: 政府合同加速与分析师上调，以及披露的政界和基金关联形成一致方向 [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。联邦反欺诈和信息共享相关提案可能强化需求主题 [bill:HRES1530] [bill:HR10326]，但散户及Stocktwits情绪已较拥挤，而且股价已明显延伸 [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。
second_order: Government data-integration theme — stronger fraud enforcement requires cross-agency analytics and information sharing
Federal cybersecurity theme — expanded law-enforcement data exchange increases security and identity-management needs
theses.dissent: The convergence may be a crowded extrapolation of prior contract wins, with sentiment and analyst signals arriving after the 60-day relative surge.

falsifier.text: Federal contract acceleration falls below prior-period growth and analyst sentiment turns negative.

theses.thesis: Institutional additions, congressional buying, a favorable Trump-linked signal, and analyst upgrades align across four channels [13f_add] [congress_buy] [trump] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. However, the stock is extended after substantial relative outperformance, so the evidence supports monitoring for a reset rather than initiating exposure.
theses.thesis_zh: 机构增持、国会买入、有利的特朗普关联信号和分析师上调在四个渠道上方向一致 [13f_add] [congress_buy] [trump] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。然而，该股在显著跑赢后已处于延伸状态，因此现有证据只支持等待估值或价格重置，而非立即建立敞口。
second_order: Cybersecurity-platform theme — institutional demand implies continued consolidation around scaled security vendors
Identity and cloud-security theme — stronger platform spending can extend into adjacent access-control and workload-protection categories
theses.dissent: All four signals can be backward-looking, and the extended price may already discount the favorable institutional narrative.

falsifier.text: Institutional filings show net reductions and congressional buying reverses while analyst sentiment weakens.
